balls.text: goes for the yorker length on leg, as Jaimeson jams that back to long-on. He wanted a second, but that was never possible there
pretty full ball on middle and leg, and he slices that to deep point from deep in his crease
short delivery on leg, and a slower ball too. Christian is down on his back knee, and also across off to try and sweep that. But the extra bounce means he can't get any connection
yorker again, but this time on middle. Jamieson clears his front leg, and is deep in his crease, as he drills that to long-off with those long levers

cleans him up! Yorker on off, and the off stump is dislodged! Bowls that right under the bat of Shahbaz at 135kph, as Shahbaz looks to heave that to the on side, but that was too good a ball to do anything with. Right where his captain would have liked, and Boult starts the final over with a dot and a wicket
pretty full and wide of off. Very close to the wide line, as Shahbaz lets that go
yorker just outside off, and Bumrah rounds off the over with a dot. Christian looks to jam at that, but that is excellently executed
that is a full-toss on leg, and he makes room to slash that to deep point off the outside half of the bat

two in two, and Bumrah is on a hat-trick! de Villiers edges it behind to the keeper. That is short of a length just outside off, and climbing on to the batter. de Villiers to upper cut that, but gets a thick edge behind, as RCB lose another one

yorker length ball on off, and that is ballooned to long-on! Looks to hoick that near yorker just outside off, but gets that off the bottom of the bat to Boult, who barely has to move to take a simple catch. A masterful innings comes to an end, with Maxwell giving RCB hope of a total near 185
tries to reverse-sweep this very full ball wide of off, but doesn't connect this time
this is almost a yorker, but this is pretty wide of off. Maxwell thinks about it for a second, but lets that go realising it was too wide
stays deep in his crease, and pulls put the helicopter shot! Bumrah goes very full on off, and Maxwell uses his bottom hand to swing that away by clearing his front leg out of the way. Phew!
low full-toss on middle and off, and that is smashed to mid-off after making room. Just a single there, as de Villiers fails to clear the man inside the circle
good length ball on off, and clipped toward deep midwicket after clearing his front leg. Brings up his fifty with that - off just 33 balls - including three sixes

short delivery, and lofts that with a horizontal bat over mid-off! Again a knuckle ball that is short and wide of off, as mid-off thinks about leaping to his left for a second, but gives up in the end
pretty full on leg, and Maxwell goes across to try and whack that to the on side, but the ball clips his pad. He is not impressed with that though
and again! This one just clears short third man. This is a low full-toss on off, and he again shapes to reverse-ramp that over the in-field. Baffling shot these
reverse-sweeps over short third man! Slower ball on a good length outside off, and Maxwell sets himself up to ramp that over the man inside the circle. Very smart there
short delivery outside off again, but this time he misses his pull. Precious dot ball for Mumbai here

tennis-bats over the bowler's head! That is some skill. It is a short delivery outside off, and there is good bounce too. He rolls his wrists over that, and lofts that for a one-bounce four. Maxwell has some chuckle after that shot
very full and wide of off. de Villiers doesn't bother chasing it, and it is called wide
very full and just outside off. Good delivery, as Maxwell can only drill it back to long-on
full length ball, but wide of off. Goes for the slash, but gets that off the inside half of the bat to long-on
creamed over long-on! Bumrah overpitches this on a full length outside off, and de Villiers sits deep in his crease and gives himself space by clearing his front leg to swing those arms powerfully
yorker first up! Lands that in the blockhole on off, as de Villiers looks to jam that back, but gets an inside edge back to the bowler
and change of pace again! Maxwell grunts out after missing out on that pull. That was short again on off, and with good bounce as Maxwell is beaten by the lack of pace and extra bounce

dances down, and top-edges this pull to deep square leg! Knuckle ball from Milne on a short of a length on off, as Kohli is too early into that shot. Gets that pull off the edge, as the substitute fielder runs in a few steps forward to complete that catch. Vital wicket for Mumbai here
another short delivery on off, which is angling in. Maxwell pulls that to long-on, as Milne goes slow this time at just 125kph
reverse-ramps that over short third man! Milne pitches that full on off, and Maxwell is already prepared to loft that while just using the pace of the bowler. Great shot!
short of deep midwicket! The fielder turns around and runs across to his left to stop that, as Kohli pulls that short ball on off
yorker length ball on off, as Maxwell stays deep in his crease to open the bat face and drill that to deep point
heaves this good length ball outside off to deep square leg. Just two off that over from Boult
goes short now. Bowls another slower ball, but this is too short and a touch wide of off too. Maxwell lets that go, and that is well within the wide line
yorker length ball on leg, and angling down further. Boult appeals for leg before, but that seemed to have been missing leg. Mumbai anyway have no review left
full and wide of off. Maxwell looks to cut that 118kph ball away from his body, but is beaten again
looks to slash at that fullish ball outside off, but is beaten, as Boult goes slow again
fifty for Kohli! Pushes this full ball on off to long-on as Boult changes his pace, and gets to another half-century

again goes for the switch-hit, but looked like he got an inside edge there. de Kock appealed for leg before, but it was not given. But Rohit reviews. No edge is confirmed by UltraEdge. Ball tracking looks like being delayed. The ball pitches on a good length outside leg, and so it remains not out. Mumbai lose a review. The ball seemed to have turning away from Maxwell, as he missed his shot and the ball hit his pad on the higher side
cuts this short ball on middle with the turn away from him, as cover dives to his right to stop that
hugeee hit over deep point! Again Maxwell goes for the switch-hit to this full delivery on leg, and targets the shorter boundary. Sends that sailing into the sky, but it still clears the fence
much fuller on his pads, as Kohli tickles that to deep square after closing the bat face
fuller and straighter on middle. Pushed back to the bowler
bowls this on a good length on middle, and gets it to turn away. Dabbed toward square leg, as Chahar gives the chase
slower ball too. Too full on off, and that is drilled back to the bowler. Milne throws it back toward Kohli, who has to enter the crease in a hurry as well as try and evade the ball
short of a length and wide of off. Kohli takes a few steps down, and tennis-bats that to long-off
looks to flick this good length ball on off, which is coming in. But that takes his front pad and rolls behind the wicket. Milne appeals for leg before, but that was always going down
good length ball on middle, and he opens the bat face to push that to cover

stays deep in his crease, and hoicks that over deep midwicket! That is bowled in the slot on off, and he clears his front leg to give himself room. That is a half-volley four as it lands just short of the rope
wide No-ball. That seemed to have slipped out his hands, as it landed beyond the pitch on the off side

starts with a short delivery on off, which Maxwell pulls to deep midwicket! The ball was angling in a touch, and there  wasn't good bounce too. Maxwell waits for it to come, and swings that full stretch
full again, and on off. Pushed down to long-on
switch-hit for six over deep point! Maxwell changes his stance really early, and goes down on his back knee to swing that full ball on leg away and beyond the man on the fence
full again, but on middle. He opens the bat face to tap that to cover
bowls this full on off again, but Kohli drives with a good stride forward. Pollard at long-off stops that at his left
skips down, as Krunal sees him early. Fires this full and just outside off, as Kohli gets an inside edge to his slash
very full and straight on middle at 100kph. He clips that to deep midwicket
very full and seemed just outside the wide line. Late call for wide
shortish in length and wide of off. Cuts this legspinner to deep point, as Bumrah runs to his left to cut that off
continues with the good length ball on middle. Kohli punches that to long-on from deep in his crease
back of a length again on middle, and another one that turns away. Pushed back to the bowler
on a good length just outside off, and turning away. Tapped toward cover with the open face of the bat
heaves this full ball outside off to deep square leg with the turn into him
short of a length on middle, and gets good bounce. Hint of turn away as well, as Maxwell blocks with the open face of the bat
hint of turn off a length, defended gently into the off side
Maxwell attempts the reverse sweep, gets a top-edge that lobs off the glove, over the keeper's head
eased down to long-off
whips this into the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on, was hitting it towards the long boundary, enough time for Milne to cut that off
fires this full and way outside the wide line, good take on the halfvolley by QDK
drifting into middle and leg, works it wide of square leg
tucks this behind square on the leg side
thick edge as he attempts a flashy drive, on the bounce to point

lofted delightfully but he has picked out the man at wide long-off. Good catch in the end, Chahar has the last laugh. But Bharat has done his job. Right intent in trying to clear the ropes, the execution was a tad off. But he can be happy with his contribution
he's clobbered this slog sweep, into the top tier at deep square! Too full, Bharat is very good with the slog sweep.
dropped at point! Oh, Hardik. This was cut hard, he put in the dive full length to his right but this just went like a rocket. Should've been taken.
clean strike down the ground! Lovely use of the feet to get to the pitch of the ball as he goes downtown, bisects long-off and long-on
backs away and lofts him inside out to sweeper cover
skids one through on a length, Kohli defends back, two tight overs from KP to pull things back
punched to wide long-off
drifting down leg, tickled to short fine, looks for a single but is sent back
flatter one on middle and leg, Bharat punches this towards Surya at deep midwicket, called for two, made it comfortably
thick edge but rolls to short third
fired full in anticipation of the batter stepping out, Bharat doesn't and it's a wide
steps out and pushes this down to long-off, Krunal saw him coming and shortened his length a touch
pushed back towards the short cover region
punches this down to long-on as Chahar shortens his length
sliced over point as the ball bounces away towards the ropes, aggressive running from Kohli to bring up the third. Milne had some work to do running around from deep cover
he's swung this cleanly into the short boundary at deep square! Fetched the slog sweep from outside off
looks to play a premeditated paddle, off the leading edge but short of short third.
turn and bounce to square Bharat up. Cracking delivery first up
steps out to swing this high full toss into the leg side, slices it towards backward point. Not a no-ball because he was advancing down the pitch
tucks this wide of mid-on for a quick single

touch short on middle and leg, Kohli tucks it to square leg and wants a run but finally decides against it, a better throw at the bowler's end from Milne and Bharat would've been walking back. Saved by a poor throw and full-length dive
leading edge but doesn't pop back, rolls towards mid-on
off the pad as he misses the slog sweep, but he was struck outside off and the ball rolls to short third
works this down to long-on as they jog the single
steered to short third as they scamper a single

what a shot! Strong bottomhands, terrific wrists, all the way for six! This was pitched up outside off, Kohli decides he wants to go leg side, takes a step across and whips him up, up and away. Incredible
sweetly timed, absolutely glorious! Kohli advances down the pitch and drives imperiously on the up between cover and mid-off.
right behind the line of this full ball as he defends to mid-on
length ball angling into middle and leg, tucked wide of midwicket
flicked to deep square
squared up by the length but manages to defend it into the off side
he's crashed that on the up between cover and point! Stood tall, opened the bat face a tad and picked the gap to perfection. Delightfully done
steered between point and short third for a quick single
not in control of the pull, certainly seemed so as he made contact, but clears the short square boundary on the leg side with the pull shot.  Kohli is the fifth batter to make 10,000 T20 runs.
lucky break for Kohli!  Gives him the charge, Bumrah bangs it short, Kohli pulls and gets a top-edge that flies over the keeper
off the bat onto the thigh pad, into the leg side for a run.
walks out to whip him over midwicket but ends up hitting it flat and straight to Hardik. Pressure building already on RCB
off a thickish inside edge to long leg. Once again, Bharat plays down the wrong line
top-edge and into the fence! Streaky. Shaped to pull but this one was angling away and flew over the slips.
driven nicely but this is a superb stop moving to his right by Ishan Kishan
right on top of the bounce as he defends back
dangles the carrot by bowling full and across, Bharat flirts with the idea of a drive but lets it go in the end

a superb nipbacker that hits Kohli on the thigh pad as it beats the inside edge. Pollard lobbed the ball to the keeper who was looking elsewhere, the batters were alert to steal two runs on the overthrow
squirts one off a thick inside edge down to fine leg. Bharat was playing down the wrong line as Bumrah went full this time.

snuffs him out! Away, away, away, and this time manages to find a thick edge as Padikkal pokes at this, QDK takes an excellent catch moving to his left.  Beat him twice, got the edge once and Bumrah has already made a mark tonight.  Padikkal made the mistake of poking at that with an angled bat.
beauty again! Goes across on a length and beats Padikkal with an absolute corker
lovely on drive, but Bumrah stops it with his left hand on the followthrough
edged but on the bounce to Surya at slip. Short of length and angling away, Padikkal squared up as he defends but played it with soft hands
makes room and bunts this short of length delivery to point
slips this down leg, good take by QDK, wide called.
taps it into the off side, wants the single but is sent back
steers this straight to short third man
full and angling away, Kohli is well forward as he defends

palmed over deep square leg by Rahul Chahar!  Would've been a super catch. This is full and swinging in, Kohli picks him off his pads, timed beautifully. Chahar leapt high to grab that but all in vain as he tipped it over the bar.
short of a length on middle, Kohli is right on top of the bounce as he defends

and the off stump comes off again! All hands up against another change of pace ball. Milne looks to flick this across the line, but it is a slower ball yet again - in fact, all four of his wickets have now with that lack of pace delivery - as Milne misses and Harshal hits again! Gets his fourth for the day, as Mumbai fold up for their lowest ever score against Royal Challengers in IPL
the legspinner now. Good length ball outside off, and with good bounce and turn away from him. Clipped to midwicket to complete a wicket-maiden

the third umpire goes upstairs after Bharat and Kohli appeal for a stumping. The ball pitches on a full length outside off, and straightens too, with no turn this time. He looks to flick that away, but is beaten. No inside edge there, so no caught behind for sure. His back foot is also grounded when Bharat whips off the bails, so it is not out
flighted, and very full and wide of off. Jammed back toward the non-striker

cleans him up! The off stump is down and out. Bumrah goes low to sweep this full ball outside off, which is again coming into him. But he plays too early, and is completely beaten by the turn, as the ball strikes the woodwork behind
another wrong 'un. This spins back in off a good length on middle, and takes his front pad
tickles this good length ball toward slip after playing close to his body. It was a googly too
slower ball again. Yorker length on middle, and jammed back toward midwicket

top edge, and flies over the keeper's head! Short delivery on off, and Bumrah goes for the pull but miscues. Not that these runs matter though, but they can help if it comes down to net run rate in the end
high-ish full-toss on middle and leg, and he presents the full face of the bat to push that to midwicket

that is a hat-trick for Harshal, and he is off in celebration! A third slower ball in a row, and it is dipping on to the batter to be a low full-toss on leg. But Chahar is clipping that from off stump rather, and is struck on the pad. Harshal knew it was out the moment he appealed, and the umpire raised his finger immediately too

clips his leg stump, and Pollard departs too! Harshal on a hat-trick. Pollard is across off a little too soon, as Harshal bowls another slower ball which is very full and dipping on middle. It angles in after pitching, and strikes his leg stump since Pollard is already across his stumps.

Kohli runs back at extra cover, and takes that skier! Hardik is beaten by the lack of pace, as Harshal goes for the scrambled seam ball on a full length outside off. He goes for the slog to the on side, but gets it off the leading edge, as the ball balloons to the off side instead. Harshal has his 20th wicket of the season, and with that, he has just pushed his side further ahead
very full and very wide of off. Hardik isn't interested in poking at that, and it is called wide
bowls this short again on leg, as Hardik pulls this from middle stump and to deep square leg
goes short of a length now on leg, with the ball angling away. Pulled forcefully to deep square leg
slower ball on a full length outside leg. Flicked to deep square after clearing his front leg
again goes really wide of the crease to bowl that slower ball on a full length outside leg. Flicked to fine leg again. Christian ended up way outside the pitch after bowling it
goes a touch fuller on his pads, as Pollard clips that to fine leg for a quick two
bowls this from very wide of the crease, and Pollard nearly drags that on to the stumps. It is a good length ball on middle and leg, and he looks to clip, but doesn't connect
high-ish full-toss on off, and clips that to deep square leg with the closed face of the bat
bowls this full and wide of off at 144kph. Pollard sees that in the driving length, but can only find point with his push
very full on off - almost a yorker - as it is drilled down to long-on
beaten outside off! Goes jabbing at that good length ball in the channel, as he looks to drive but misses
starts with a yorker length ball on middle, with a hint of angle away from the batter, who drives it back to mid-off with the full face of the bat with after being a little off balance

nabbed at short third man! Siraj bowls this fullish and really wide of off. It is an offcutter too, as Suryakumar goes fishing at that away from his body, while also presenting a horizontal bat. The ball flies off the top edge to Chahal, who takes a sitter. It would have been a wide easily had he left that alone
continues with that back of a length ball on middle, as he tucks that to midwicket and they complete rapid run. Kohli's throw at the keeper's end is pretty wide too
good length ball on off and turning in again, and clipped to the left of short fine leg

huge appeal for leg before by Maxwell, and not given. And Kohli reviews after a long period of thought. Short of a length ball on off, and turning into the batter, who misses his flick with the ball hitting his front pad nearly around leg stump. No inside edge is confirmed. The ball pitches is turning and bouncing big, and is shown to be going over leg. So RCB lose their review
low full-toss on middle, and that is driven down to long-on
good length ball on off, and this was quicker too. Clipped to deep square leg to get off the mark

off stump is uprooted! Pitches that short on middle, as Krunal dances down to try and swing that away toward deep midwicket or thereabouts. But he seemed to be too early into the shot, as the ball hit his pad and ricocheted to the off stump. Another wicket for Maxwell, and his impressive show today continues
on the bounce to long0off! Fuller ball and in the driving length on off, as he presents the full face of the bat to loft that right back
again a change of pace. This is really full - in fact it is a low full-toss - just outside off, as he swings that across the line to long-on
chips this good length ball on off toward long-on, as he is completely foxed by the lack of pace. Just a late lob from Krunal, but safe, as Harshal gives the chase

bouncer on middle, and there is an appeal for caught behind by Bharat. Not given by the umpire. And Kohli chooses not to review. That pitches on off, and flies over the batter, who tries to pull. Wide called
slower ball on a good length outside off He goes wide of the crease to bowl that too, as Krunal jabs at that toward cover rather uncomfortably
really full on middle, and angling down leg. Takes his front pad, as Harshal appeals for leg before, but that was always sliding down. The ball trickles off his pad for a leg-bye
slices this full ball outside off to deep point by leaning forward. They gobble a quick two there
again a pretty full length ball just outside off. Presents the full face of the bat to caress that to long-on
skips down to this full ball on off and heaves across the line. But he gets that from the inside half of the bat to deep midwicket
shortish in length, and wide of off. Cuts this to point for another dot
good length ball on off, and he closes the bat face to clip that to dee square
much fuller on off, and driven down to long-off
goes to cut this short ball just outside off but is beaten, since he plays that from too close to his body
this is fuller and tossed up on off, as Krunal lofts that to long-on aerially. There was a call of "catch it", but that bounced way too early
full ball on middle, and he closes the bat face to clip that to midwicket
tossed up ball on a very full length ball on off, and driven to cover with that turning out to be a low full-toss. Jamieson dives to his right to keep that to a dot

leading edge, and skied to short third man! Kishan's poor run of form continues. He skipped down to this full ball on off, which was turning away from him a touch after pitching, as he looked to hoick that away to the on side. But that is mistimed, as the bat face closes, and he sends that for an easy take
tossed up, and full on off. Driven to long-off with the full face of the bat
good length ball on middle, and the wrong 'un. Opens the bat face to dab that to short third man

he's hit this straight to long-on! Rohit was looking to muscle this over but didn't quite get hold of it, was the blow off the previous delivery the reason for him not getting enough power? Either way, RCB won't really bother because they know they've got a massive strike.
tucks this wide of the bowler, towards mid-on

oh dear, he's stepped out and whacked Rohit on the wrist! The physio will need to run out with some cold spray. Kishan absolutely smashed that back. Oh, dear. Rohit is wincing in pain. This was coming straight towards Rohit's face so he got his glove in the way to try and prevent that.  Rohit is back up on his feet and will carry on.
tucks this wide of midwicket, sensible from Rohit
whips this to deep midwicket
punched down to long-on
drifts in a legbreak on middle, worked wide of square leg
breaks away from a length on off, Rohit defends to point, sends Kishan back immediately
this is a wrong'un which he chips down and hits it one bounce to long-on
nicely tossed up, Kishan lunges forward and defends back
goes straight, clears the infield. Lovely hit downtown. Got to the pitch
shortish on middle, he rocks back and mistimes this pull to midwicket
monstrous hit over deep midwicket! Saw this tossed up over his eyeline and Rohit didn't hold back as he swung through clean
slips this down leg, has to rebowl that
shortish on middle and leg, worked to deep square
lunges forward and turns this to long-on
another leading edge, just short of Maxwell. Stopped on him
nearly chipped back! Kishan plays for turn, there isn't much here as he defends
shortish and spinning in, tucked to short fine
works this to deep square, superb first over
gets well forward and defends this tossed up delivery

he's hoicked this to deep midwicket where Maxwell takes a good, low catch diving forward. Chahal did de Kock in flight, got this to dip and turn as well. Got the feeling that de Kock ended up dragging it a bit. Such delightful legspin bowling
tossed up on middle and off, QDK pushes it into the covers
beaten as he tries to reverse sweep. Hit on the pad but it pitched way outside leg
eased down to long-off as Chahal drifts in a legbreak
slower and fuller, defended towards short third. Good first over from Harshal
he's belted this pull through square leg, down to Padikkal at the rope
slower bouncer outside off, but it's way over the head. Rohit let that go anticipating a wide, and wide it is
pulled but down towards Christian who runs around from wide long-on
digs it into the pitch, Rohit bunts it to short third, didn't have much pace to work with
slower length ball angling in, pushed wide of cover
starts off with a slower and fuller delivery on middle, defended.
helped along to the deep square leg region where Shahbaz makes a right royal mess, overran the ball and sprayed it to the boundary.
sat up nicely, pulled away to deep square again
steps out and pulls this to deep square where Padikkal throws himself full stretch to save two runs
good stop at point by Shahbaz! This was a slower length ball, QDK backed away and absolutely crashed that
backs away and thrashes this length ball, it's a screamer. No one bothered to chase that to the cover point fence
right in the slot and QDK pumps him down the ground. Friendly half-volley
beaten for pace as he tries to squeeze out this quick yorker outside off. 145.3kph
goes down the ground and he has managed to get enough bat to find the boundary. This was cross-batted from Rohit
squeezes this yorker-length delivery to point

full on leg-stump, QDK misses a mow into the leg side. They try and pinch a leg bye, Siraj does well in running across to get to the ball and fire a throw at the bowler's end. QDK would've been gone had that hit . Siraj clocked  147kph  with that one
width and he reaches for this to crash it between cover and cover point. He saw QDK making room and sprayed this a tad wide, QDK has good hands and reach
overpitched slower ball, driven straight to cover point
beats mid-on to make that three in a row! No timing as he looks to swing this across the line, but found enough bat. 17 off the over.
flayed away behind square on the off-side! Just a hint of width, Rohit got nice and low, opened the bat face as he put that away behind point. Beautiful
full toss, belted down the ground for four! That was a gift Rohit wouldn't refuse for the world
tumbling stop at deep midwicket as they come back for a second. This was an uppish flick from Rohit, but hey, Jamieson has overstepped and a freehit is coming up
beaten as he has a mow at this slower delivery
backs away, Jamieson follows him to tuck him up, QDK taps it into the off side as they scamper a run
length outside off, Rohit runs this down to third man
picked away off the pads, beats Shahbaz's dive at deep square leg, much-needed boundary
mistimes a pull, on the bounce to Kohli. Late on this 144.4kph short ball
low full toss, flicked superbly but Kohli right up to the task as he throws himself to his left to stop at that midwicket. Saved a certain boundary
full and swinging back in to hit the pad but the impact was outside leg. QDK looking to whip this up and over but was beaten for pace
off an inside edge to short fine, Rohit playing outside the line of a length ball
gets this to nip away off a length to square Rohit up as he gets a leading edge that lands short of point
flicked uppishly, one bounce to Padikkal at deep square
full toss and swinging into middle and leg, a surprised de Kock taps this down to mid-on
chops this down towards short third, no chance of a single
walks across to scoop it fine, but doesn't get enough bat on this. Harshal comes around to cut that off at fine leg
good ball, big appeal for lbw but the ball pitched outside leg. QDK looking to defend but was deep inside the crease and was hit high on the pad too.
back of a length and skidding into middle and leg, tucked to deep square to get off the mark
